My dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
[Miss Sewell](/person/1301) is in want of a volume of Milmans Latin Christianity which the [London Library](/organisation/29) does not send. She will write to you which it is and perhaps you could kindly cause it to be sent to her. I cant think what [Clay](/organisation/173) meant by our delaying the [proofs](/book/71) for we had never done so.
I have never had any of [Heartsease](/book/19) to put the headings to the pages.[^2]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
